from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689749/attempts/31c36fde4a524b3f9529214b2feb9fae/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # The framed shapes are rectangular rings, separated from the background.
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 6)
    for color in counts:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for c0,c in pts) if False else max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for c in range(c0+1,c1): out[r][c]=2
        if r1-r0==2 and c1-c0==2: out[(r0+r1)//2][(c0+c1)//2]=7
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-10ade90e.py'; p.write_text(code)

code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==6 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==color:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            r0=min(y for y,x in pts); r1=max(y for y,x in pts)
            c0=min(x for y,x in pts); c1=max(x for y,x in pts)
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1): out[y][x]=2
            if r1-r0==2 and c1-c0==2: out[(r0+r1)//2][(c0+c1)//2]=7
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
